Departmental Activities

About the Course

Established in 2008, as one among the departments of the Faculty of Engineering and Technology, this department participates in B. Tech and M. Tech. programs offered by the Faculty. In addition. The M.Tech program imparts instruction in the basics of engineering science, The program has earned a prestigious position for itself among similar programs available in the country. The department teaches the subjects of Chemistry, English, Mathematics, Physics and Social Science in the B. Tech. programs and Mathematics in the M. Tech programs. We feel ecstatic to introduce you to the Department of Applied Sciences and Humanities, which is the foundation of Engineers. The department strives for increasing the knowledge, enhancing critical thinking, ability to change information into knowledge and the power of analyzing the things technically of every individual of ever-changing society through students. The department is an inseparable part of a vibrant and dynamic institute that guides and gives the faculty members the wholehearted support to nurture engineering students through their academic journey. The department plays a vital role in an engineering college catering to the teaching of Applied Science courses for engineering students of all branches.  Our Laboratories have been very well established to cover complete syllabus and motivate students to learn beyond the syllabus, which definitely develops complete knowledge of the subject (both the practical and theoretical depth of knowledge) and develop skill sets of students to become promising engineers in future. English Language Lab and Soft Skills is the distinctive feature of the department which focus on all components of English i.e. listening, speaking, writing and reading along with personality development classes. Our focus is to produce Engineers equipped with modern applied science tools with a strong understanding of the real world of engineering problems. Department of Applied Science & Humanities encompasses and is the footprint to embark the proficiency in the streams of Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English. The faculty members adhere to the high standard of teaching and actively involve students in the educational experience. Our faculty members are actively involved in research activities and have published papers in various National / International reputed Journals. 

Our Vision

To create skilled biotechnology professionals who can innovate, invent, and disseminate knowledge for the betterment of society and the protection of the environment.

Our Mission

-  [] To nurture competent biotechnologists for the bio-industry who contribute to national growth through research and development.
-  [] To inculcate principles of bioethics, safety regulations, and strong moral and ethical values among students.

Prof.(Dr.) Shailesh Nath Pandey has been awarded Ph. D. degree in Mathematics from Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University, Gorakhpur in 2001. The broad area of his research is ” A STUDY OF SHOCK WAVE PROBLEMS ” in Applied Mathematics.The area of his research has wide applications in the field of Engineering.His Research Thesis has been supported by five international good publications. He has completed his M.Sc. degree in Mathematics from DDU Gorakhpur University, Gorakhpur campus in 1994 and has been enrolled for Ph.D degree in 1995 under the supervision of Prof.(Dr.)R.C.Srivastav,
Fellow DAAD(Germany)
Fellow Alexander Von Humboldt Foundation(Germany) General Secretory ISMAMS
Fluid Dynamics and Shock Waves Research Group, Former Head,
Department of Mathematics & Statistics
DDU Gorakhpur University Gorakhpur(U.P).
He has been started teaching during research in 1998.
He has been attended and presented his papers in so many seminars & conferences.
He has also completed Orientation Course, Work Shops and So many FDP programs sponsored by UGC and AICTE.
During his academic journey One Ph.D degree in Mathematics has been awarded under his supervision.

HoD Message

[GITM Lucknow]

PROF.(DR.) SHAILESH NATH PANDEY

Ph.D (Mathematics) 

 Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University,

Gorakhpur

At Goel Institute of Technology and Management, we believe that a strong foundation in Applied Sciences and Humanities is essential for shaping competent engineers and responsible global citizens. The department plays a pivotal role in nurturing analytical thinking, scientific temperament, and effective communication skills among students.

Our focus is not only on academic excellence but also on the holistic development of students. Through a well-structured curriculum, experienced faculty, and continuous engagement in innovative teaching practices, we aim to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application.

We encourage our students to develop curiosity, critical thinking, and ethical values that will guide them throughout their professional journey. The department also emphasizes research, interdisciplinary learning, and skill development to meet the evolving demands of industry and society.

I extend my best wishes to all students for a successful and enriching academic journey. Together, let us strive for excellence and contribute meaningfully to the nation and beyond.

Program Educational Objectives (PEO)

[] []

-  [] PSO1: Develop the ability to understand, demonstrate, identify, analyze and apply the skills and knowledge gained from foundational courses of Applied Science and Humanities, and relate these fundamentals with core subjects in the relevant field. 
-  [] PSO2: Provide knowledge of modern skills in technology through self-learning in the areas of design, analysis and innovation of scientific and engineering domains.
-  [] PSO3: On completion of the program the students are well poised to pursue careers in academia, industry and the other areas of Science and Engineering.

Program Outcomes (PO)

[] []

1.  Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
2.  Problem analysis: Identity, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
3.  Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
4.  Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions..
5.  Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modelling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
6.  The engineer and society: Apply to reason informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
7.  Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
8.  Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
9.  Individual and teamwork: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10. Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
11. Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
12. Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

Program Specific Outcomes (PSO)

[] []

-  [] Apply the concepts of electronics, communications, signal processing, VLSI, Control systems etc. in the design, development and implementation of application oriented engineering systems.
-  []  Solve complex problems in the domain of Electronics and Communication using latest hardware and software tools, along with analytical and managerial skills to arrive at cost effective and optimum solutions, either independently or as a team.
-  [] Apply technological leadership with ethical responsibilities, to built real world applications accommodating with dynamic technological changes while considering social & environmental issues.

About the Department

The Department of Biotechnology Engineering is continuously committed to providing quality education that nurtures professional excellence among students. Established in 2014, the department envisions developing skilled bioengineers capable of working in interdisciplinary areas of biotechnology for the welfare of the nation, society, and the environment. Biotechnology is a rapidly evolving, research-driven field, and the department focuses on preparing students for careers in industry and research organizations through a dynamic and updated curriculum.

The department is supported by well-qualified faculty members from eminent universities with strong research credentials and proven publication records. Faculty are proficient in delivering effective teaching through both online and offline modes. Current research thrust areas include Molecular Biology, Genetic Engineering, Plant Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Immunology, Bioprocess Technology, Food Biotechnology, and Nano-Biotechnology. To strengthen research and practical training, the department houses well-equipped, state-of-the-art laboratories, including Genetics and Molecular Biology, Genetic Engineering, Biochemistry and Analytical Techniques, Microbiology and Immunology, Food Biotechnology, Plant Tissue Culture, Bioprocess and Fermentation, Bioinformatics, and Nano-Biotechnology laboratories. Additionally, the institute is recognized as an official nodal center of Virtual Labs, IIT Kanpur (an initiative of the Ministry of Education, Government of India), providing students with enhanced virtual laboratory learning experiences.

Our Vision

To emerge as a leading department in the country by delivering high-quality education and fostering an excellent learning environment that equips future biotechnologists with strong knowledge, academic excellence, and a competitive edge in the professional world.

 

Our Mission

-  [] To offer a comprehensive biotechnology-based educational program aimed at developing a skilled and quality workforce.
-  [] To create awareness about the vast potential of biotechnology along with its socio-ethical implications.
-  [] To develop well-trained biotechnology professionals capable of contributing to the continuous improvement of biotechnological services and products.

Head of Department

Mr. Ahsan Masood done  M.Tech . He has more than 11 years of teaching experience at the UG and PG levels. He has taught diverse subjects which include microbiology, immunology, bioprocess engineering, genetic engineering, genetics, and molecular biology. He has already published two research articles and has co-authored one book chapter. He has attended various International Conferences, seminars, and workshops.

Welcome to the Department of Biotechnology. We stand at the threshold of a biological revolution where the fusion of biology and technology is solving some of the world’s most pressing challenges—from healthcare and food security to environmental sustainability.

About the Course

Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at Goel Institute of Technology and Management Lucknow (GITM) was founded when the institute came into existence in 2008 and has been serving as a place of study for many decades. The GITM is one of the best institutes providing excellence in education with its excellent quality of teaching in the field of computer science in the state of Uttar Pradesh. The department provides courses of B. Tech. program in Computer Science,  Engineering and M.Tech. Program in Computer Science & Engineering. The department has always maintained a dynamic and advanced level of teaching to keep pace with the latest trends of information technology environment. It has been a constant effort of the department to change and develop its courses according to the needs of constantly developing IT environment of India.
The B. Tech. program in Computer Science & Engineering of the GITM comprises comprehensive syllabus of computer science with special focus on practical learning and experience. The department ensures that the curriculum of courses offered are designed in a way that keeps our students updated with the latest development of computer science; engineering. The faculties of Goel Institute of Technology and Management Lucknow (GITM) have excellent academic backgrounds along with strong research experience; thus they provide quality education to our students in form of expert classroom lectures. The department is equipped with modern infrastructure facilities including computing laboratories with high speed Ethernet and wireless network facilities.

Our Vision

To provide a congenial environment for learning in discipline of Computer Science and Engineering, and to mobilize students towards serving a globalized technological society.

Our Mission

-  [] To ensure that every engineering student is proficient with necessary computer skills.
-  [] To familiarize students with latest developments in Computer Science and Information Technology and motivate them to embrace all challenges and be future ready.
-  [] To inculcate strong ethical values, research capabilities, professional behavior and leadership abilities in your character so as to work with a commitment to the progress of the nation.

Computer Science and Engineering
HoD Message
Dr. Anita Pal is an accomplished academician and researcher in the field of Computer Science and Engineering, currently serving as Professor and Head of the Department (CSE)
at Goel Institute of Technology and Management, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. She holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from the Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET), Lucknow, where her research focused on biometric evaluation using electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. With over 11 years of teaching and research experience, Dr. Pal has contributed significantly to higher education through her expertise in subjects such as Data Structures, Python Programming, and Theory of Automata. Her research interests lie in the areas of biometric recognition, machine learning, and biomedical signal processing. Dr. Pal has published several research papers in reputed SCI, ESCI, and Scopus-indexed journals and conferences. Her notable work includes contributions to ECG-based biometric systems and arrhythmia classification using deep learning techniques. In addition to her academic contributions, she holds patents in areas related to smart healthcare systems and AI-powered technologies.

About the Department

The B.Tech. program in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) is designed to prepare students for the future of technology-driven industries. As Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning continue to transform every sector, this program equips students with the knowledge and skills required to build intelligent systems, automate processes, and solve complex real-world problems.
The curriculum blends core computer science fundamentals with specialized knowledge in AI and ML, enabling students to understand how machines learn, analyze data, and make decisions. Through hands-on learning, real-world projects, and exposure to modern tools and technologies, students gain practical experience that enhances their employability and innovation capabilities.
The program not only prepares students for high-demand careers but also encourages them to become creators, innovators, and researchers. With a strong emphasis on analytical thinking, problem-solving, and emerging technologies, students are empowered to contribute to advancements in industries such as healthcare, finance, automation, robotics, and smart systems.

Our Vision

To be a global leader in AI/ML education and research, producing skilled professionals who drive innovation, solve real-world problems, and promote ethical, sustainable growth.

Our Mission

-  [] Foster Innovation: Encourage research and hands-on projects to solve real-world problems using AI/ML.
-  [] Industry Readiness: Prepare students for careers by offering industry collaborations, internships, and cutting-edge tools.

About the Department

Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) is a dynamic and rapidly evolving discipline that focuses on the design, development, testing, and deployment of electronic and communication systems. ECE engineers play a crucial role in conceptualizing, implementing, and supervising the manufacturing of electronic, communication, and broadcasting systems that enable fast, reliable, and efficient global connectivity. The discipline encompasses core areas such as basic electronics, microprocessors, analog and digital communication, integrated circuits, antennas, and wave propagation. It also contributes significantly to the design and production of modern electronic devices, circuits, and communication equipment.
The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Goel Institute of Technology and Management (GITM), Lucknow, was established in 2008. The department offers B.Tech (4-year) and M.Tech (2-year) programmes, both affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow. The department is supported by well-established laboratories, including the Electronics Lab, Communication Lab, PCB & Electronics Workshop, Integrated Circuit Lab, and Microprocessor Lab. These laboratories are equipped with modern testing and measuring instruments, hardware kits, and licensed software as per curriculum requirements. To strengthen digital and experiential learning, the department actively utilizes Virtual Labs, e- learning platforms, and online certified courses offered by IITs through NPTEL, SWAYAM, and Spoken Tutorials (IIT Bombay). GITM is an official nodal center of Virtual Labs, IIT Kanpur, an initiative of the Government of India. Since its inception, the department has shown consistent growth and has taken proactive initiatives to deliver quality technical education while fostering innovation and research aptitude among students. The department actively engages in teaching, research, and industry- oriented activities across emerging and interdisciplinary domains. Major research areas include Embedded Systems, Microelectronics and VLSI, Internet of Things (IoT), Signal Processing, and Communication & Networking. In recognition of student innovation and research efforts, one final-year student project was selected under the CST-UP Project Grant Scheme 2025 on a funding basis. Additionally, one student team was selected for the AICTE Productization Fellowship 2025 and successfully pitched their product at the Regional Meet 2025 held at Varanasi, organized by the Ministry of Education’s Innovation Cell, Government of India. Students of the department regularly qualify the GATE examination, and alumni are placed in reputed private-sector organizations, pursuing higher education at premier institutions, or successfully running startups. Faculty members are highly qualified, with significant contributions in journal publications and patents. The department also promotes creativity and holistic development through its quarterly E-cum- Wall magazine, showcasing students’ innovation, technical ideas, and literary skills under the URJA Departmental Student Club. Students have also secured positions in AKTU zonal- level technical and literary events, reflecting their all-round excellence.

Vision of Department

To provide quality education in Electronics and Communication Engineering, emphasizing research and addressing societal needs while adapting to advancing technological revolution with global challenges.

Mission of Department

-  [] M1: To provide quality education with a focus on practical knowledge, fostering innovation and expertise in the field of Electronics Engineering.
-  [] M2: To develop technically proficient engineers for the communication sector and semiconductor industries while addressing societal needs with strong ethical and moral values.
-  [] M3: To empower students through industry, academia and alumni interactions, solving complex technological problems of current times, fostering collaboration and multidisciplinary activities for excellence in niche technology.

About the Department

Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) is a dynamic and rapidly evolving discipline that focuses on the design, development, testing, and deployment of electronic and communication systems. ECE engineers play a crucial role in conceptualizing, implementing, and supervising the manufacturing of electronic, communication, and broadcasting systems that enable fast, reliable, and efficient global connectivity. The discipline encompasses core areas such as basic electronics, microprocessors, analog and digital communication, integrated circuits, antennas, and wave propagation. It also contributes significantly to the design and production of modern electronic devices, circuits, and communication equipment.
The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Goel Institute of Technology and Management (GITM), Lucknow, was established in 2008. The department offers B.Tech (4-year) and M.Tech (2-year) programmes, both affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow. The department is supported by well-established laboratories, including the Electronics Lab, Communication Lab, PCB & Electronics Workshop, Integrated Circuit Lab, and Microprocessor Lab. These laboratories are equipped with modern testing and measuring instruments, hardware kits, and licensed software as per curriculum requirements. To strengthen digital and experiential learning, the department actively utilizes Virtual Labs, e- learning platforms, and online certified courses offered by IITs through NPTEL, SWAYAM, and Spoken Tutorials (IIT Bombay). GITM is an official nodal center of Virtual Labs, IIT Kanpur, an initiative of the Government of India. Since its inception, the department has shown consistent growth and has taken proactive initiatives to deliver quality technical education while fostering innovation and research aptitude among students. The department actively engages in teaching, research, and industry- oriented activities across emerging and interdisciplinary domains. Major research areas include Embedded Systems, Microelectronics and VLSI, Internet of Things (IoT), Signal Processing, and Communication & Networking. In recognition of student innovation and research efforts, one final-year student project was selected under the CST-UP Project Grant Scheme 2025 on a funding basis. Additionally, one student team was selected for the AICTE Productization Fellowship 2025 and successfully pitched their product at the Regional Meet 2025 held at Varanasi, organized by the Ministry of Education’s Innovation Cell, Government of India. Students of the department regularly qualify the GATE examination, and alumni are placed in reputed private-sector organizations, pursuing higher education at premier institutions, or successfully running startups. Faculty members are highly qualified, with significant contributions in journal publications and patents. The department also promotes creativity and holistic development through its quarterly E-cum- Wall magazine, showcasing students’ innovation, technical ideas, and literary skills under the URJA Departmental Student Club. Students have also secured positions in AKTU zonal- level technical and literary events, reflecting their all-round excellence.

Vision of Department

To provide quality education in Electronics and Communication Engineering, emphasizing research and addressing societal needs while adapting to advancing technological revolution with global challenges.

-  [] To impart knowledge of the fundamentals of Management theory and its application in problem solving and apply appropriate tools for decision making required for solving complex managerial problems.
-  [] To develop sound knowledge of the entrepreneurial process and inculcate creativity and innovation among students
-  [] To produce industry ready graduates having highest regard for Personal & Institutional Integrity, Social Responsibility, Teamwork and Continuous Learning

Program Outcomes (PO)

[] []

1.  The MBA program is a student-centric program with the objective of developing a career in diverse sectors of the industry domestically and globally. The MBA program not only facilitates learning in theory and practice of different functional areas of management but also equips the students with an integrated approach to various functions of management. The curriculum is designed in a way that Institutes, Faculty and Students will shift their focus from a traditional methodology that excessively focuses on industry towards broad-based learning, encompassing the end to end processes involved in developing entrepreneurial skills looking at needs and demands of broader sections of the society.

    1. To assimilate the understudies with the imperative space information, abilities and right mentality important to give the successful initiative in a worldwide climate. 

    2. To foster able administration experts with solid moral qualities, fit for expecting a significant job in different areas of the Indian Economy & Society.

     3. To teach proactive intuition to guarantee powerful execution in the dynamic financial and business environment.

     4. To bridle innovative methodology and ranges of abilities lined up with the public needs.

Program Specific Outcomes (PSO)

[] []

-  [] To work successfully as a Management Graduate with the requisite skill set for marketing, finance and human resource domain as acquired from the respective specialized domain. To impart knowledge gained from the compulsory Summer Internship Project (eight weeks) in the industry as per the requirement of the concerned organization.
-  [] To educate students with proficiency in the specific area of specialization in Master of Business Administration and help them to show their competency in the understanding of marketing, finance and how to make workforce in the industry with the requisite skills of HRM.
-  [] Periodic workshops, industrial visit and seminars are being arranged for students consistently throughout the course for a better understanding of the subject knowledge and also to equip them with requisite skills of the industry.
